notes: The pool sizes itself to all available logical CPUs; the verified host has 18. Each final range requires at least 524288 pixels (2 MiB).
Small ranges (65536 pixels) regressed in two paired live trials. Keep them as failures, not acceptance data for the final policy.
Coarse gains are small relative to host contention and variance; no reliable FPS improvement or 60 FPS claim.
The coarse native bridge includes concurrent shadow experiments disabled in every control, candidate and diagnostic by VOX_DISABLE_HIDDEN_CONTENT_SHADOW_SKIP and VOX_DISABLE_ROOT_SHADOW_REGIONS.
Paired timing used explicit native candidates. A subsequently completed shared production build was checked in a fresh installed process; its diagnostics are not performance acceptance.
